steps.text: We're an online retailer in Indonesia. Our site goes down every flash sale and checkout gets slow; last 11.11 we lost a lot of orders. Design something on Alibaba Cloud.
About the assumption “Flash sale traffic spikes 10x+ normal load”: It's more like 50x in the first five minutes after a flash sale opens, and almost all of it comes from our mobile app.

turns.text: We're an online retailer in Indonesia. Our site goes down every flash sale and checkout gets slow; last 11.11 we lost a lot of orders. Design something on Alibaba Cloud.

I'll design a flash-sale-ready retail architecture in Jakarta with auto-scaling compute, caching, and queue-based checkout to prevent downtime.
Web servers auto-scale for flash sales. Checkout orders go through RocketMQ so the database never gets overwhelmed.
Monitoring and logging ensure you see flash sale issues before customers do.
